task.title: Create lineage-read-svc HTTP service from scratch
task.summary_zh: 從頭建立 services/lineage-read/ 最小可部署服務：實作 GET /api/v1/lineage（依 artifact_id/run_id/strategy_id 查詢 lineage 鏈路）、GET /api/v1/lineage/{id}、POST /api/v1/lineage（寫入）、/__health__，補 main.py、Dockerfile、requirements.txt，加入 docker-compose.yml。
task.next: Owner finalized: all artifacts committed (main.py, Dockerfile, requirements.txt, docker-compose.yml wiring). Codex review approved; live build and API smoke checks passed. Task closed.
review_notes_zh: - 已重讀 services/lineage-read 與 docker-compose.yml，路由、healthcheck、資料目錄與 task brief 一致。|- 以目前工作樹執行 docker compose build lineage-read、docker compose up -d lineage-read，容器進入 healthy。|- 實測 /__health__ 200、POST /api/v1/lineage 回傳 201、GET /api/v1/lineage 與 filter 查詢正常、GET /api/v1/lineage/{id} 可讀回剛建立紀錄。|- 無阻擋驗收的缺陷，已核准交還 owner 正式收尾。

commit_metadata.All artifacts delivered: main.py (GET /api/v1/lineage, GET /api/v1/lineage/{id}, POST /api/v1/lineage, /__health__), Dockerfile, requirements.txt, docker-compose.yml wiring. Codex review approved.

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Copilot while Codex completes higher-priority work.

services/lineage-read/ is complete: main.py with GET /api/v1/lineage (filter by artifact_id/run_id/strategy_id), GET /api/v1/lineage/{id}, POST /api/v1/lineage (201), GET /__health__; Dockerfile uses python direct exec to avoid module-path issues with hyphenated dir; docker-compose.yml gains lineage-read service on port 8094 with healthcheck and lineage-data volume. All endpoints smoke-tested via live server.
Review approved: current lineage-read implementation and compose wiring satisfy the task brief; live build/up plus API smoke checks passed. Returned to Claude for final done transition.
